alignment Description of Problem: The touch screen buttons do not match where the screen needs to be touched to activate the command. Operator needs to push above, below, right or left of the button for the command to take effect.
Troubleshooting: Touch screen calibration in required. Proceed as follows. 1) Power down the cutting system.
3) Remove finger after the "Power On Setup" screen appears.
4) Using the left and right arrows to navigate, go to the Calibration Screen (screen page 2). Press Touch screen to begin calibrating.
5) Using a paper clip or fine tip object, press the center of the cross as shown. The cross will reappear in the lower right corner. Press the center of the cross.
6) Navigate to screen page 3. Select save and exit to complete calibration.
The touch screen will restart in normal mode. Check for proper screen operation and begin your normal start-up procedure.

source.text: tional pause Description of Problem: The machine stops in middle of cut and displays message “Machine Paused, Press Zero, Next or Abort” on Touch Screen. When pressing NEXT on the keypad, the machine will continue to cut where it left off. This is typically caused by an intermittent pause circuit, usually in thestop discs.

Troubleshooting: 1.Check stop disc activation. The stop discs should not activate by a slight touch or vibration. They should activate only when moved by minimum pressure. Remove gantry side cover. Check the pause plunger. Tighten the plunger to increase activation pressure and loosen to decrease activation pressure.

proposal: 1. FailureMode 'Intermittent pause circuit, usually in the stop discs' -> RESOLVED_BY -> CorrectiveAction 'Remove the gantry side cover' [repair]. Meaning: The failure mode may be resolved by the specified corrective action.

2. FailureMode 'Intermittent pause circuit, usually in the stop discs' -> RESOLVED_BY -> CorrectiveAction 'Tighten the pause plunger to increase activation pressure' [repair]. Meaning: The failure mode may be resolved by the specified corrective action. Conditions: To increase activation pressure.

3. FailureMode 'Intermittent pause circuit, usually in the stop discs' -> RESOLVED_BY -> CorrectiveAction 'Loosen the pause plunger to decrease activation pressure' [repair]. Meaning: The failure mode may be resolved by the specified corrective action. Conditions: To decrease activation pressure.

source.text: RF/EMI Interference Some factory environments may have equipment that gener- ates Radio Frequency (RF) or Electro-Magnetic Interference (EMI). These signals in close proximity to the Eastman cutting system can generate electrical noise and cause problems for the machine and computer (Eastman does offer a shielded mouse). It is recommended that any RF Welders or other equipment generating RF or EMI noise be a mini- mum of 75 feet (23 meter) from the Eastman cutting system.

Problems of this nature are typically difficult to resolve and must be approached in a systematic manner. To reduce the effects of electrical noise generated by RF, Eastman Ma- chine Company has the following recommendations:
Step 2) Enclose all AC power cables in rigid conduit and secure to the earth ground. Route the four power cables for the computer controls around the end of the conveyor instead of under the unit.

answers.rationale: The manual requires touchscreen calibration for the misalignment problem, gives these steps as the calibration procedure, and directs checking screen operation after restart.

The manual identifies electrical short, software tool mapping, and power supply as possible causes, while the holder, pressure, and connection items are checks rather than stated failure modes or component relationships; the Tools ON check is also separate from the mapping check.

The manual directs checking that the software is open and, if there is no green LED, checking the cabinet outlets; it only directs checking the cord and fuses if there is no AC power, without stating that they are faulty.

answers.text: Keep statements 2 and 3; removing the gantry side cover is an access step, not a remedy.
answers.rationale: The troubleshooting entry prescribes tightening or loosening the pause plunger to adjust activation pressure, but removing the cover only enables access to the check and is not stated as a remedy.

answers.text: The manual recommends routing the four computer-control power cables around the conveyor end to reduce the effects of electrical noise; it does not state that this will resolve the interference.
answers.rationale: The cable-routing instruction is explicitly one of the recommendations for reducing electrical noise effects, but the excerpt does not claim it will resolve the problem.

answers.text: The manual describes the problem and advises checking laser power and cutting speed, but does not state that an unsuitable setting may cause the path to be too wide.
answers.rationale: The excerpt prescribes checking the settings and notes that they may vary by material; it does not identify an unsuitable setting as a cause of this symptom.
The excerpts prescribe checks of pressure, tool connections, LEDs, solenoids, and an air-manifold cable, but do not state that either failure mode affects the proposed components.
